transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I suppose I'm here because... I've just had this feeling lately. It's not a loud feeling, but it's stubborn. I just keep thinking that the best years of my life are already behind me. And no matter what I do—no amount of planning or discipline—is going to get me back to feeling like myself again. It just feels a bit hopeless, honestly.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been quite a while. It really started after a hiking injury I had... that was a little over three years ago. I'd say it's been about three years and three months now, just steadily feeling like this.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, elated, or hyperactive?
No, I haven't. I mean, before the injury I had a normal amount of energy, but... nothing unusual or extreme like that. I've never really been a hyperactive person.
During these past three years, have you had any periods lasting two months or more where you felt completely like your normal self?

No, not really. There hasn't been any stretch of time like that. It's just been a constant, low-level feeling this whole time... never a break for as long as two months where I felt completely normal again.
During these past three years, has there ever been a time when your low mood became significantly more intense or severe for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. It hasn't ever really spiked into something severe like that. It's just been that same steady, flat feeling the whole time... I haven't had a couple of weeks where it suddenly got a lot worse or anything.
